en: {fb:3380}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How much do dragons eat, I wonder?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}A dragon's appetite, huh... Actually, I've hardly ever seen 'em eat.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Their daily rhythm seems a little off from humans'...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, I bet they eat more than me, at least. Otherwise there's no way they'd get that huge.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Which do you like better, food from the sea or from the mountains?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Huh? Just the sea and the mountains? Stuff from the river's good too, y'know...? Didn't you know that, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is something troubling you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...Nah. Sure, I was fishin' to unwind, but it's not like anything's botherin' me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You're so serious, Angel... Thinkin' that just 'cause I'm fishin'.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Nah. Not at all. I was just takin' it easy... Don't worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Well, if I'd had a big one on the line, maybe you would've been.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I guess I'm kinda worn out in spirit. ...I haven't caught a single one...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Kinda. It's a good way to unwind. Wanna try fishin' with me, {name:0080}?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did someone teach you that?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Nah. I learned on my own. I watched other people do it and copied 'em.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}So, sadly, I don't catch much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you fish often?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Now and then, on nice days. It calms me down, and if I catch somethin', it fills my belly.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you eat the fish you catch?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Well, of course. If I don't eat 'em while they're fresh, it ain't fair to the fish.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1F80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Kinda. It's a good way to unwind. Wanna try fishin' with me, {name:0080}?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you eat the fish you catch?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Well, of course. If I don't eat 'em while they're fresh, it ain't fair to the fish.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well... yeah. You went and picked me as a hero, after all.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Besides, I don't want blood spilled 'cause of my mistakes. The only way is to keep trainin', bit by bit.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Lately I feel like my arms have gotten weaker. Gotta build 'em back up a bit.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. A little longer. I'm just gettin' into the swing of it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What kind of training are you doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Sword basics. If you've got the basics down right, you shouldn't lose many fights.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Nah, if I rest now it won't count as trainin', so I'll keep goin'.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You were lookin' out for me, huh. Thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did the dragons teach you how to use a sword?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}They didn't teach me any practical moves, but they taught me the right frame of mind for the sword...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Not that I understood much. It was all really hard stuff.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope your training pays off soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...Nah, I'm not hopin' for that. Truth is, I don't wanna hurt anybody.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's just, there'll be times when there's no other way... So, it's to be ready when it counts.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2980}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Nah, if I rest now it won't count as trainin', so I'll keep goin'.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}You were lookin' out for me, huh. Thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not reeeally. It's not like you're bothering me. ...Did you come all this way just to ask that?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}A little. I've been walking foreverrr...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I'd like to say I do... but walking around isn't really my thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Of course. Otherwise I couldn't take it. Walking all over the place like this.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Normal. Just normal. Not good, not bad, I guess.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You were worried about me? But wait, does that mean you think I'm not reliable?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Hehe, so you think so too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}There's all kinds of stuff outside the castle, so it's supeeer fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Me? Hoping to see YOU?! As if!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Quit saying dumb stuff and hurry up and do your job!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmmm. I'm okay for now, I guess.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...... You didn't come all this way just to say that, did you...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you come across any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah. There were tons of pretty places.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}The view from the castle's pretty too, but the scenery you see while traveling like this is lovely too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did I startle you, showing up so suddenly?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}...Are you stupid or something?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah, yeah. You don't have to worry about me that much, thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Let's see...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I know. Could you sing me a song or something? Just traveling around gets kinda boring.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I-I'm not lost... yet!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What about ships, or shared carriages?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I take ships sometimes, and they're nice. They feel great.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But crowds are a no-go. It's so cramped.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything that gives you trouble on your travels?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It's a problem when I can't make it to a town by nightfall.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Then I have to camp outside... and that's really rough.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FF81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So, what do you want?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4780}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Why would I be hoping to see you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Quit saying weird stuff and hurry up and do your job.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8380}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If there's anything I can do, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Let's see...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I know. Could you sing me a song or something? Just traveling around gets kinda boring.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might have lost your way.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}I-I'm not lost... yet!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Meals are fun, aren't they?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah, they are.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}The food in towns has stuff you'd never get to eat in the castle, so I always look forward to it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Don't worry about it. Besides, if I thought someone was bothering me, I'd chase them off right away.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are there foods you don't like?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}...... You don't need to ask weird questions!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever cook your own meals?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Of course! Now that's a good question!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}A lady who took care of me once when I snuck out of the castle taught me how to cook.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}So I'm pretty confident about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You haven't eaten yet either? Then... Well, it doesn't feel like an "eat together" thing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hurry back and have something to eat.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is it different from the food at the castle?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, most of it's different. But not always.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sometimes town cooking tastes better, even with the same ingredients.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like sweets?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Whaaat?! Why are you asking that?!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I was just thinking about going to eat some. Weird...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2980}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You haven't eaten yet either? Then hurry back and have something to eat.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is something troubling you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not really...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Oh, wait, there is... How to get rid of you right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}It's fine. You're not bothering me. Of course, if you did, I wouldn't forgive you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah, just a little. But I'm gonna kick back now, so I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Well, duh! Thanks to you, I've been doing all kinds of stuff!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I can't let loose and have fun at times like this, how am I supposed to keep going?!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did someone teach you that?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}How to have fun? They never taught me that at the castle.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}The townspeople taught me while I was out and about. Stuff about business too.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Were you able to play at the castle?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Let's see. When I was little, I used to play with the maids.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But once you get older, they don't play with you as much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}By then, though, I'd already started sneaking outside the castle to play.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did you find anything nice?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Oh, yeah. The other day I found the cuuutest necklace.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Next time I go there, I'm totally getting it!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yeah, just a little. But I'm gonna kick back now, so I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So! What else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Hmhm. Well, duh. I'm a responsible girl, y'know. When it's time to do it, I do it!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Kinda. Even against some lame monster, I don't wanna look bad.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Lady Ashe's battles always have to be beautiful, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sure am. I seem to be on a roll today.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What kind of training are you doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Hmm? Right now? Right now it's dagger throwing. I'm doing pretty well.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Are you worried about me? Then, thanks. But I'll do a little more first.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
